request: Add a definition of Riesz potentials if they are used, otherwise rename; give every result mentioned in the book a complete, detailed proof; replace hypotheses stronger than the proofs use by the most natural version.

author_decisions.riesz_potentials: not used in the body; Chapter 4 renamed 'Potentials, energy and capacity'
author_decisions.external_inputs: resolution of singularities and log principalization (thm:analytic-resolution-input, thm:marked-order-one-input; EI-RES) remain the only results used without proof

proof_standard: complete proof in place; or exact earlier internal statement cited by \cref; or reader prerequisite (undergraduate real analysis incl. several-variable differential calculus and Lebesgue integration, linear algebra, point-set topology, elementary one-variable complex analysis); or EI-RES. final sweep of proof-internal references and gap phrases (11 groups) with an independent check of each group
cross-file pass turning shared facts into statements, with an independent check
notes alignment with an independent check
coordinator: cross-unit routing, small citation and layout edits, full builds
